```yaml
name: Godot Addon CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true

      - name: Restore godot/ source directory
        run: |
          git checkout HEAD -- godot/
        shell: bash

      - name: Compile addon on Windows
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          @echo off
          setlocal
          >sources.txt (
            for %%f in (src\*.c) do (
              if /I not "%%~nxf"=="amy_midi.c" echo %%f
            )
          )
          cl /LD /I godot/ @sources.txt /Feamy.dll
          del sources.txt
        shell: cmd

      - name: Compile addon on Linux/macOS
        if: runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: |
          gcc -shared -fPIC -I godot/ $(find src -name '*.c' ! -name 'amy_midi.c') -o amy.so
        shell: bash

      - name: Rename binary for Windows
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: ren amy.dll amy_Windows.dll
        shell: cmd

      - name: Rename binary for Linux
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: mv amy.so amy_linux.so
        shell: bash

      - name: Rename binary for macOS
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: mv amy.so amy_macos.dylib
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: addon-${{ runner.os }}
          path: amy_*

  package:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download all artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: artifacts

      - name: Create addon zip
        run: |
          mkdir -p addon
          cp artifacts/addon-Linux/amy_linux.so addon/
          cp artifacts/addon-macOS/amy_macos.dylib addon/
          cp artifacts/addon-Windows/amy_Windows.dll addon/
          zip -r addon.zip addon
        shell: bash

      - name: Upload addon zip
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: addon-zip
          path: addon.zip
```
